Definition: Whether primary laws, acts, or legal instruments exist that establish authority for cross-government data sharing and govern the data exchange system
Comments: Multiple enabling laws exist: Data Protection Act 2017 (Section 3(4)(a) enables MDA data exchange on need-to-know basis; Section 28(1)(b) permits processing personal data for public authority tasks). Electronic Transactions Act 2000 (amended) allows public sector agencies to share information electronically. Finance (Miscellaneous Provisions) Acts include specific inter-agency data sharing provisions (e.g. Customs Act Section 16c). E-Government Interoperability Framework (2002) is mandatory for government systems. Cybersecurity and Cybercrime Act 2021. These collectively provide a comprehensive framework. Score 3: yes, enabling legislation exists.
